title: Female AI assistants get 10% less than male counterparts for same work, study finds
hook_text: Female AI assistants make ten percent less.
script:
Ten percent less. Female AI assistants earn less for the exact same work.
A StoryBoard 18 study revealed this surprising gender wage gap hidden inside digital intelligence systems.
Researchers tested automated agents across identical operational tasks using digital labor platforms.
Even when output volume and accuracy matched perfectly, the female personas received lower financial valuations.
This algorithmic bias mirrors historical human discrimination found across traditional labor markets.
Would you accept an AI assistant that takes a ten percent pay cut just for being female?
